# Welcoming Alex Noakes to Infinite


By[Nikhil Srinivasan](https://infinite.net/company/about) , Founder & CEO


·


July 16, 2026


·


1 min read


Alex Noakes has joined Infinite as our Founding Member of Technical Staff, helping to shape and lead our product engineering.


Alex has worked at the intersection of traditional and blockchain financial services and product engineering, as both a practitioner and a product leader.


Welcome to the team, Alex.
